title: [WT-17a] Docs: the daemon's landed worktree contracts in MCP_SERVER.md, SCHEMA.md
description:
This row is carved out of WT-17 (task-cda65eb0), at the governor's re-slice request of 2026-10-31. It follows the C02 precedent: the independent part ships now, and the remainder keeps its deps. WT-17 still waits on WT-14 and WT-16 for its docs/CONFIGURATION.md half. This half documents only daemon contracts that have already landed: WT-01, WT-02, WT-03 and WT-03b, all DONE. So it can start today. WT-17 then re-verifies these two docs and adds nothing to them unless a later slice changed a contract.

Objective: docs/MCP_SERVER.md and docs/SCHEMA.md describe the worktree contracts the daemon already ships. Each is described once, and spelled exactly as the code spells it.

Deliverable:
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md, inside each tool's existing section:
  - claim_next_task and get_context: the top-level `workspace: { mode, path, branch, target }`. Say which replies carry it. Only a WORKING claim on a worktree-mode project gets mode 'worktree'.
  - complete_task: the worktree branch rule, moe/task/<taskId> (state/validators.ts).
  - finalize_attempt: outcome 'unlanded'. Document its fields:
    - unlandedReason, one of conflict, contention, gate, diverged, remote;
    - conflictPaths;
    - rescueRef, which must be task-scoped under refs/moe/rescue/<taskId>/;
    - optional targetTip.
    Also document the routing from REVIEW back to WORKING or BLOCKED, which sets Task.landingRetry.
- docs/SCHEMA.md, with names, optionality, unions and null exactly as in packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts:
  - ProjectSettings.worktreeMode (WorktreeMode 'off' | 'on');
  - ExecutionAttempt.workspaceMode (ExecutionWorkspaceMode 'shared' | 'worktree') and its AttemptWorkspace;
  - Task.landingRetry (LandingRetry | null);
  - UnlandedReason.

Take every spelling from the landed code: types/schema.ts, state/validators.ts, tools/claimNextTask.ts, tools/getContext.ts, tools/completeTask.ts and tools/finalizeAttempt.ts. Where docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md disagrees with the code, the code wins. Name each such drift in a moe.add_comment on WT-17 (task-cda65eb0).

NOT in scope:
- docs/CONFIGURATION.md, and every wrapper-side name: MOE_* codes, env vars, the git-land-<target> resource, refs/moe/board and moe/control. These stay with WT-17 until WT-08..WT-14 land.
- CLAUDE.md, scripts/CLAUDE.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and the role docs (WT-18).
- WT-14's worktree removal and WT-16's doctor behavior.
- Any code change.

Verification (run from the repo root):
npm run lint && for k in 'mode, path, branch, target' 'moe/task/' unlanded unlandedReason conflictPaths rescueRef targetTip landingRetry; do grep -qF -- "$k" docs/MCP_SERVER.md || { echo "MCP_SERVER.md missing $k"; exit 1; }; done && for k in worktreeMode WorktreeMode workspaceMode ExecutionWorkspaceMode AttemptWorkspace landingRetry LandingRetry UnlandedReason; do grep -qF -- "$k" docs/SCHEMA.md || { echo "SCHEMA.md missing $k"; exit 1; }; done
definitionOfDone: docs/MCP_SERVER.md documents, each in that tool's existing section and spelled as in the tool code: `workspace: { mode, path, branch, target }` on claim_next_task and get_context; the complete_task worktree branch rule (moe/task/<taskId>); and finalize_attempt 'unlanded' with unlandedReason, conflictPaths, rescueRef, targetTip and its REVIEW-to-WORKING/BLOCKED routing.

docs/SCHEMA.md documents ProjectSettings.worktreeMode, ExecutionAttempt.workspaceMode with AttemptWorkspace, Task.landingRetry (LandingRetry) and UnlandedReason, with names, optionality, unions and null matching packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts.

This task's commits change only docs/MCP_SERVER.md, docs/SCHEMA.md and its own board record. No wrapper-side name (an MOE_* code, env var, git-land-<target>, refs/moe/board or moe/control) and no unlanded behavior is documented.
The verification command in the description exits 0.

implementationPlan.description:
docs/MCP_SERVER.md: document the landed worktree contracts inside each tool's EXISTING section. Add no new top-level section. Check every sentence against the code line it describes; the code wins.

(a) `### moe.claim_next_task`, response block: add `workspace?: { mode: 'shared' | 'worktree', path: string, branch: string | null, target: string | null }` next to attemptId/generation, plus one short **Workspace (WT-01)** paragraph.
- It is present exactly when the claim names a worker and opens or adopts an attempt (tools/claimNextTask.ts ~885: `...(claimedAttempt ? {attemptId, generation, workspace} : {})`). Say which answers lack it: no workerId, and hasNext:false.
- The value is resolveAttemptWorkspace(attempt, settings) (state/validators.ts) and is never taken from claim arguments.
- Only a WORKING claim while settings.worktreeMode is 'on' records mode 'worktree': path `<projectPath>/.worktrees/<taskId>`, branch `moe/task/<taskId>`, and target the trimmed settings.consolidationBranch when it is a non-blank literal without `*`, `?` or `[`, else 'main' (resolveWorktreeTarget).
- Every other claim records 'shared': path is the project path, branch and target are null.
- The mode and path are pinned on the attempt at claim time, so a resume never switches the checkout.

(b) `### moe.get_context`: the top-level `workspace`, the same shape (tools/getContext.ts ~553 and ~689).
- Present on default and view:'full' reads of a task that has a current attempt.
- Omitted when there is no attempt or its record does not decode.
- Confirm in code and tests: whether view:'status' carries it, and that it sits inside the hashed packet and outside role trims.
- mode and path come from the pinned attempt, but target follows the live consolidationBranch.
- Also mention `task.landingRetry`, present only while set (~646).

(c) `### moe.complete_task`, the worktree branch rule (checkWorktreeBranchPolicy in tools/completeTask.ts).
- When the task's attempt is a worktree attempt, `currentBranch`, trimmed, must equal `moe/task/<taskId>` exactly.
- Otherwise it is refused CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION, message prefix `BRANCH-POLICY-FAIL`, context { currentBranch, expectedPattern }. This runs before the shared consolidationBranch policy and before any write.
- A missing currentBranch keeps the warning path.
- Shared attempts are unchanged.

(d) `### moe.finalize_attempt` (tools/finalizeAttempt.ts): add 'unlanded' to the outcome union in the Parameters block and add its four parameters.
- unlandedReason: 'conflict' | 'contention' | 'gate' | 'diverged' | 'remote' (UNLANDED_REASONS).
- conflictPaths?: string[], normalized project-relative, at most 500 kept.
- rescueRef: at most 255 chars, exactly `refs/moe/rescue/<taskId>/<segment>`, with segment matching /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$/.
- targetTip?: 40 hex, or null.
- landedRevision must be omitted or null.
- The outcome is valid only for a worktree attempt; anything else is refused INVALID_INPUT before any write.

Then the routing:
- A REVIEW task goes to WORKING unassigned, keeping reopenCount and completed steps.
- It goes to BLOCKED instead (blockedFromStatus WORKING, with a blockedReason naming the rescue ref) for 'diverged', or from the third consecutive unlanded finalize on.
- A task not in REVIEW keeps its status.
- Each unlanded finalize sets `Task.landingRetry = { reason, paths, rescueRef, targetTip, count, at }` and posts a task comment.
- A 'landed' or 'nothing-to-commit' finalize sets it to null.
- Spell out that the stored field is `paths` while the parameter is `conflictPaths`.

From WT-03b, one sentence only if the code confirms it: landingRetry is daemon-owned (a board UPDATE_TASK echo is stripped), and a release keeps a completed-step retry WORKING.

Link to docs/SCHEMA.md for the shapes. Write with the Edit tool only; another open row also declares this file. Error handling stays exactly as the code has it: document refusals; never invent one. Testing is the grep gate in step 4.
implementationPlan.note: Documented workspace on claim_next_task/get_context, worktree branch rule on complete_task, finalize_attempt 'unlanded' (params, routing, clearing, errors). All checked against code. Edit tool only. Other dirty paths belong to peers, untouched.

implementationPlan.description:
docs/SCHEMA.md: document the four schema contracts with names, optionality, unions and null exactly as in packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts. Copy the wording of its doc comments, shortened.

- `## Project`, settings block: `worktreeMode?: 'off' | 'on';`, the WorktreeMode type. Absent means 'off' (resolveWorktreeMode, state/validators.ts); any other value is refused. 'on' runs each new WORKING claim in `<projectPath>/.worktrees/<taskId>` on `moe/task/<taskId>`, read once at claim time and pinned on the attempt.
- `## Task` interface: `landingRetry?: LandingRetry | null;`. finalize_attempt alone sets it; landed and nothing-to-commit null it; it is absent until the first retry. Add a short `### landingRetry (WT-03)` subsection beside the existing Task subsections. It holds `type UnlandedReason = 'conflict' | 'contention' | 'gate' | 'diverged' | 'remote'` (from UNLANDED_REASONS) and `interface LandingRetry { reason: UnlandedReason; paths: string[]; rescueRef: string; targetTip: string | null; count: number; at: string }`, with each field's comment from schema.ts. Note that finalize_attempt's `conflictPaths` parameter becomes `paths`.
- `## ExecutionAttempt` interface: add `workspaceMode?: 'shared' | 'worktree';`, the ExecutionWorkspaceMode type. The claim sets it once; it is absent on older records, which read as 'shared'; there is no migration and no version bump. Extend the `workspace` comment: the project path, or the task worktree for a worktree attempt. Then add `interface AttemptWorkspace { mode: ExecutionWorkspaceMode; path: string; branch: string | null; target: string | null }`. It is the claim and get_context projection, never stored; branch and target are null for shared attempts. Link to docs/MCP_SERVER.md.

Add no wrapper-side name and no unlanded behavior: nothing from WT-08..WT-14, no MOE_* code, env var, git-land-<target>, refs/moe/board or moe/control. Write with the Edit tool only. Error handling and test coverage: this step adds no behavior; the step-4 gate checks the spellings.
implementationPlan.note: Added worktreeMode, landingRetry/LandingRetry/UnlandedReason subsection, workspaceMode and AttemptWorkspace to SCHEMA.md; Edit tool only. (Edits were made before start_step was called for this step; started it afterward to record state.)

implementationPlan.description:
Drift audit (description deliverable, no file edit). Compare docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md with the landed code for every contract documented in steps 1-2. The code wins.

Leads to verify, then keep or drop:
- The plan's W path is `<git top>/.worktrees/<taskId>`; claimNextTask.ts joins state.projectPath.
- The plan's §2 finalize call omits the optional `targetTip` parameter.
- The plan says landingRetry clears on the next 'landed' finalize; the code also clears it on 'nothing-to-commit'.
- The plan does not say a non-REVIEW task keeps its status.
- The get_context target follows the live consolidationBranch while mode and path are pinned.
Add any other drift you find.

Post ONE moe.add_comment on WT-17 (task-cda65eb0) listing each drift as plan text, then code, then file:symbol. If there is none, say so explicitly. Do not edit the plan doc: it is not in scope.
